text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, thank you so much for the<n>wonderful
birthday present. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: You're very welcome! I had fun too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
...Did you really like it, though? Was<n>playing catch
together actually a good<n>gift?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Of course. It had been such a long<n>time. It reminded
me of our childhood.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ehe, I used to ask you to come<n>outside and play all
the time!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
We'd play catch and tag... You know,<n>I learned so
much from you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
And it's no different now that we're<n>at the
academy. It's just that now,<n>your lessons are on
how to seize<n>victory.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I'd better keep up my running skills<n>to set a good
example then! Let's<n>both train hard, Bright!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes, and I'll continue to practice my<n>throwing. I
want to be able to reach<n>you without bouncing the
ball.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, I'd be happy to practice that<n>all you want!
